app.description: See where you are heading, where you are now, and what to do next.

home.body: The Path home arrives in the next milestone. This build proves the foundations underneath it.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: You are offline. Pages you have opened before still work. Reconnect to load this one.

styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.intro: Tokens, type and core components. Every screen in the app is built from these.

usage.ink: Base. Text, rules and inverted surfaces.
usage.accentSignal: State: alert, pain flag, the one primary action. Fills carry white text.
usage.accentElectric: State: booked, live. Fills carry white text. Never used as text on ink.

type.monoSample: Everything in the app supports or guides you on your path: your goal, your stages, your log and your coach.

shape.radius: Corners are square. Radius is 0 everywhere; a full pill is reserved for small tags.
shape.dividers: Lists are separated by thin dotted rules, not rounded cards.
shape.motion: Motion is quick and mechanical ({duration} ms) and switches off when reduced motion is requested.
shape.targets: Touch targets are at least 44 px.

stageTrack.label: Stages towards your goal
stageTrack.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

chart.title: Weekly load
chart.note: Black line, thin rules, monospace axes. One accent marks the current week.

cover.why: Because I want to race the Zurich 10K with my club.
